smoke.notes: node --test auto-discovery, 0.7s, offline, zero deps. Additional dog-food: node examples/vibe-distill.js --check -> '[distill] --check re-verify: PASS' (3 pinned, 3 silenced, 0 refused; ledger verify true); node src/cli.js scan jev-ci.ledger.jsonl -> 'CHAIN VERIFIED - 13 receipt(s), ALIVE - 4 event(s), 7 silence(s) booked, admission 36.4%'. Negative: invoking `node --test test/` (explicit dir arg) fails with one opaque test error in this Node version — `npm test` is the working invocation.

essence: homeostatic iteration: rest-and-react on surprise, every silence receipted, living threshold ratchets

ideas.name: Rest and react, don't poll
ideas.statement: Replace `for (event of stream)` with an iterator that pulls until the stream's KL gain surprises a sliding boundary belief, then yields once — an agent stops burning context on repetition; the first pull only seeds the belief (no belief, no refusal).

ideas.name: Every silence is booked
ideas.statement: A silenced pull writes a hash-chained receipt — a silence you cannot audit is indistinguishable from a hang; scanLedger turns a ledger into a named reading (TAMPER / EMPTY / QUIET / ALIVE), and the chain basis is pinned to the fleet café vector so receipts cross-verify across repos.

ideas.name: The ratchet (living threshold as armor)
ideas.statement: The threshold is mean + k·σ over ADMITTED gains, so a world oscillating at any fixed amplitude is silenced after exactly one admission — adversarial resonance is impossible by construction; Throttle sheds familiar calls, MergeGovernor rests the queue for a fixed length, and the EWMA variant restores the descent path when admissions starve.

ideas.name: Lifecycle organs (distill + dream)
ideas.statement: The same gate machinery compiles judgment over time: the vibe-to-spec distiller pins only cited, novel, well-formed lessons (repeats book silence; malformed input refuses with a receipt, never throws), and dreaming consolidates old WAL rows into summaries with originals relocated, never deleted.

ideas.name: Surfaces (CLI, TUI, MCP)
ideas.statement: The iterator is reachable from anywhere: zero-dep CLI (tail/follow/scan/digest), an ANSI TUI that renders silences as data, and an MCP stdio server whose tools (jeviter_tail/next/throttle/ledger_verify) turn any client's poll into a rest.

parts.name: fnv1a-64 chain basis (café pin)
parts.essence: BigInt FNV-1a 64 over UTF-8 bytes, pinned to the fleet vector fnv1a64("café Δ 日本語") === 0x24a555471370b18d so jeviter receipts cross-verify with jev-quilt's Bookkeeper, duke-lab's WASM port and quilt-engine-ports' GDScript from byte one.
parts.gate: café vector equality holds (pinned by tests)
parts.failure_mode: an unpinned hash would silently fork the fleet's receipt chains

parts.name: Q16 exact rationals
parts.essence: exact BigInt n/d rational pair with add/mul and float projection — profiles are exact rationals; KL is computed over rationals, never a float identity.
parts.gate: identity comparisons never pass through floats (floats live in the gain, not the identity)
parts.failure_mode: float probability identity would make equal texts compare unequal

parts.name: letter-class profile organ
parts.essence: distribution of a text over five letter classes (vowels/cons/digits/sep/other) — dense, smooth, stable: the shape-organ that makes ordinary prose comparable.
parts.gate: empty/whitespace text normalises against total=1 (no divide-by-zero)
parts.failure_mode: letter-class is shape-blind to single-leaf flips — which is why profileValue exists (P06)

parts.name: klGain
parts.essence: KL divergence of the new reading from the boundary belief over shared support; the surprise number the whole iteration loops on.
parts.gate: p==0 or q==0 shared-support terms contribute nothing (documented semantics)
parts.failure_mode: honest negative of record: blind to CATEGORICAL REPLACEMENT — a flipped verdict digit scored exactly 0.0 in the w2 coroner receipt

parts.name: klGainStrict (categorical replacement law)
parts.essence: the night-lab receipt folded home: vanished mass (p>0,q==0) and novel mass (p==0,q>0) each count at FULL weight — a category swap is maximal news, not silence; klGain untouched for backward compat.
parts.gate: three independent lanes' falsifiers (flipped verdict digit, fixed-grammar stream, maximally different essays) book non-zero
parts.failure_mode: without it, maximally different inputs read as silence

parts.name: profileValue leaf-class organ
parts.essence: distribution over a structured row's JSON leaf classes keyed `path=value` exactly (no binning) — the organ that sees ONE leaf flip inside receipt rows.
parts.gate: 'verdict=ok' -> 'verdict=fail' is a full class move (~1/leaves-per-row mass), the falsifier that killed coroner v1
parts.failure_mode: binning would dilute the flip back into silence

parts.name: dynamicThreshold
parts.essence: the threshold is alive: mean + k·σ over admitted gains — a fixed line is a target; this moves.
parts.gate: no admissions yet -> threshold 0 (the seed path stays open)
parts.failure_mode: admissions-only statistics can freeze under starvation (cured by P08)

parts.name: dynamicThresholdEWMA (starvation cure)
parts.essence: baseline = EWMA over ALL pulls, admitted or silenced; amplitude = population σ over all pulls; state.ewma persists across calls — the ratchet keeps amplitude-invariance while the EWMA restores the descent path.
inputs: seed gains, all gains, alpha, k, state
parts.gate: baseline moves on silences too ('25 quiet samples let the baseline forget the day')
parts.failure_mode: cures the found-DEAD org-watch state (threshold frozen at 0.100476, 81 rows, zero admissions, no way down)

parts.name: hash-chained receipt ledger
parts.essence: every pull outcome (seed/silence/event/exhausted/shed/escalated/held/merged) is booked as a body string whose fnv1a-64 becomes the chain tail; verify() replays from genesis and tamper breaks at its own row.
parts.gate: verify() false on any mutated body; a ledger that verifies with 0 events is receipted QUIET, not a hang
parts.failure_mode: unbooked silence would make downtime unprovable

parts.name: seed law (no belief, no refusal)
parts.essence: the first pull establishes the boundary belief and books a 'seed' row — seeding is not news and never yields.
parts.gate: first pull MUST NOT yield as an event (law 1, pinned by tests)
parts.failure_mode: counting the seed as news would emit a phantom event on every boot

parts.name: silence booking
parts.essence: a pull whose gain is under threshold is booked as a 'silence' row carrying gain and threshold to 6 decimals.
parts.gate: EVERY silenced pull is booked (law 2) — admission accounting stays exact
parts.failure_mode: dropped silences would turn a quiet stream into an unauditable hang

parts.name: event admission + belief update
parts.essence: gain above the live threshold updates the belief, pushes the gain into the admitted set, and yields {text, gain, threshold, pulls, tick} exactly once.
parts.gate: yield happens iff gain > threshold (admission)
parts.failure_mode: yielding on equal gain would let fixed-amplitude noise through

parts.name: scanLedger honest readings
parts.essence: replays a persisted ledger from genesis and names what the silence pattern says: TAMPER (naming the breaking row) / EMPTY / QUIET (receipted quiet, not a hang) / ALIVE with admission percentage.
parts.gate: broken chain names its own row; QUIET is a verdict, not an error
parts.failure_mode: a scanner that fails on quiet would costume honest idleness as a crash

parts.name: Throttle (anti-DoS ratchet)
parts.essence: wraps any fn: the first call seeds the boundary; familiar calls are SHED (receipted, return undefined), surprising calls escalate; the belief window keeps the last 16 payloads.
outputs: fn result or undefined (shed) + ledger rows
parts.gate: a flood of identical requests self-sheds after exactly one admission — alternating payloads cannot buy perpetual escalation (law 4)
parts.failure_mode: a shed that wasn't booked would be silent request loss

parts.name: PR shape signature
parts.essence: shapeOf(pr) = sorted top-level areas + churn magnitude bucket (S<50, M<300, L) — the belief currency of the merge governor.
parts.gate: signature is order-insensitive (areas sorted) — file order cannot fake divergence
parts.failure_mode: path jitter would manufacture novelty

parts.name: MergeGovernor rest law
parts.essence: sequential-merge homeostasis: seed merge first; divergent shapes merge then rest the queue for a FIXED restLen count of held PRs; familiar shapes merge quietly; every hold books a receipt.
parts.gate: rest length is fixed (restLen held PRs), NOT time — wall-clock smuggling is not a release mechanism (law 3); one divergent shape buys exactly one rest
parts.failure_mode: time-based release would let a jammer pace the queue open

parts.name: readGovernor audit readout
parts.essence: pure readout of governor state: merged/held/rests counts, queueOpen, the belief window contents, chainVerified, and admission rate to 4 decimals.
parts.gate: chainVerified surfaces ledger integrity with every readout
parts.failure_mode: a readout that hid chain state would split judgment from evidence

parts.name: distill CITATION gate
parts.essence: every lesson must cite >=1 transcript line (T<n>) and every cite must resolve; unresolved or absent cites are REFUSED with the reason named.
parts.gate: unresolved cite -> REFUSED (never silently pinned)
parts.failure_mode: an uncited lesson would launder vibes into spec

parts.name: distill DUP silence gate
parts.essence: a lesson whose normalized-text hash is already pinned is booked as SILENCE in the admission accounting — repeats never re-pin; hashes bind normalized text so markdown whitespace jitter cannot rewrite a pinned lesson.
parts.gate: already-pinned hash -> silence, never re-pin (dormancy is not costume)
parts.failure_mode: re-pinning by presence would inflate the spec with duplicates

parts.name: distill WELL-FORMEDNESS re-parse
parts.essence: the RENDERED stub is re-parsed and verified: provenance fields present, every lesson carries hash/see/referenced_by, cross-refs bidirectional — the check would catch a hand-edited lie.
parts.gate: hand-edited stub fails re-parse against recomputed transcript hashes
parts.failure_mode: a stub trusted because it was just rendered would skip exactly the forgery case

parts.name: never-throw refusal receipts
parts.essence: malformed input yields a refused receipt and an honest empty stub, never a throw — refusal is data.
parts.gate: no code path throws on malformed input (NEVER-THROW doctrine header)
parts.failure_mode: a throw would convert bad input into an unbookable crash

parts.name: dream consolidation (receipted sleep)
parts.essence: consolidates the OLD tail of a memory WAL into summaries; originals are RELOCATED to achieved/dormant state (never deleted); summarize returning null REFUSES and refusal is a first-class receipt — a dream you cannot source is a rumor and is never booked as memory.
outputs: dream summary + hash-chained dream receipt (dreamId over {summary, sourceIds})
parts.gate: summarize null/undefined -> refusal receipt (precondition); no source entry is ever deleted
parts.failure_mode: deletion instead of relocation would erase the audit trail of what was forgotten

parts.name: MCP stdio server
parts.essence: streams-as-handles MCP server exposing jeviter_tail, jeviter_next, jeviter_throttle, jeviter_ledger_verify (plus ADE bridge tools) so any MCP client's poll becomes a rest.
parts.gate: named handles only — unknown handle refuses rather than guessing
parts.failure_mode: leaking handles across clients would cross-contaminate beliefs

parts.name: CLI + TUI surfaces
parts.essence: zero-dep command surfaces: tail (file), follow (URL with --k), scan (verify chain + name the silence pattern), digest (stdin), tui (live ANSI instrument panel rendering silences as data).
parts.gate: scan names the silence pattern; TUI renders quiet as data, not as failure costume (test-pinned)
parts.failure_mode: a TUI that renders quiet as an error would invert the doctrine

cells.expr: klGain(base, reading) = Σ p·log(p/q) over shared support
klGainStrict: vanished/novel mass counts at full weight
threshold = mean(accepted) + k·σ(accepted)  (EWMA variant over ALL pulls)
next(): seed if no belief; silence if gain<=th; event + belief update if gain>th
ledger.book(state, payload, kind) on EVERY pull outcome; fnv1a64 chain
Throttle.call: shed (receipted) vs escalate (fn runs) — ratchet after one admission
distill: CITATION + DUP + JEV GATE + WELL-FORMEDNESS -> CANON stub
consolidateMemory: old WAL tail -> summary + receipt; originals relocated

layer_logic.0: exact primitives: UTF-8 fnv1a-64 pinned to the fleet café vector, BigInt rationals, floats only inside gains — identity never floats
layer_logic.1: sensation and admission: three organs (letter-class, leaf-class, strict-KL) turn text/rows into distributions; the iterator loop seeds, silences, or admits against the living threshold
layer_logic.2: policy laws pinned by tests: no belief no refusal; every silence booked; threshold mean+k·σ (EWMA cure for starvation); fixed-count rest; shed/escalate ratchet; never-throw refusals
layer_logic.3: surfaces: CLI tail/follow/scan/digest, ANSI TUI, MCP stdio tools, ADE bridge — every surface reads or books the same ledger
layer_logic.4: evidence: fnv1a-64 chained ledger with row-exact tamper naming, scanLedger's named readings (QUIET is a verdict), governor readouts, dream receipts binding {summary, sourceIds}
